items.exampleEn: The school offers classes for cyberaddicts who want to spend less time online.
items.exampleZh: 學校為想減少上網時間的網路成癮者開設課程。

items.exampleEn: We found a small cybercafe near the hotel and printed our tickets there.
items.exampleZh: 我們在飯店附近找到一家小網咖，在那裡印了車票。

items.exampleEn: My daughter's cyberpet makes a happy sound when she plays with it.
items.exampleZh: 我女兒陪她的電子寵物玩時，牠會發出開心的聲音。

items.exampleEn: The sentence "What a beautiful day!" ends with an exclamation mark.
items.exampleZh: 「What a beautiful day!」這個句子以驚嘆號結尾。

items.exampleEn: The computer's hard drive stopped working, and I lost all my files.
items.exampleZh: 電腦的硬碟壞了，我的檔案全都不見了。

items.exampleEn: Taiwan is famous for its high-tech industry.
items.exampleZh: 台灣以高科技產業聞名。

items.exampleEn: Netsurfers left thousands of comments under the funny video.
items.exampleZh: 網友在那支搞笑影片下面留了好幾千則留言。

items.sentenceEn: Don't use an exclamation mark in every sentence of a work email.
items.sentenceZh: 工作用的電子郵件，不要每個句子都用驚嘆號。

items.audioEn: My laptop's hard drive is almost full, so I'm deleting some old videos.
items.audioZh: 我筆記型電腦的硬碟快滿了，所以我正在刪掉一些舊影片。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要刪掉舊影片？
options: The old videos were of poor quality
It is running out of space

items.sentenceEn: The new train station is very high-tech, with robots that answer questions.
items.sentenceZh: 新的火車站非常高科技，還有會回答問題的機器人。

items.sentenceEn: When I was a child, I had a cyberpet that I had to feed every day.
items.sentenceZh: 我小時候有一隻電子寵物，每天都得餵牠。

items.stemEn: The ____ charges fifty dollars an hour for a computer and a drink.
items.stemZh: 那家網咖一小時收五十元，包含電腦和一杯飲料。

items.stemEn: The factory uses ____ machines that can work without people.
items.stemZh: 那家工廠使用不需要人操作的高科技機器。

items.passageEn: Twenty years ago, there was a cybercafe on almost every street in my town. Netsurfers paid by the hour to play games, chat with friends and send emails with an exclamation mark in every line. My cousin spent so many nights there that his parents called him a cyberaddict. Most of those cafes have closed, because nearly every home now has fast internet. However, the one near my old school is still open. It has become a high-tech gaming center with huge screens. The owner even keeps an old computer with its original hard drive, so visitors can see what the internet looked like two decades ago.
items.passageZh: 二十年前，我們鎮上幾乎每條街都有一家網咖。網友按小時付費，在那裡玩遊戲、和朋友聊天，寄出每一行都有驚嘆號的電子郵件。我表哥在那裡待了太多個晚上，他爸媽都說他是網路成癮者。那些網咖大多已經關了，因為現在幾乎家家戶戶都有高速網路。不過，我以前學校附近那家還開著。它變成了一間有巨大螢幕的高科技遊戲中心。老闆甚至保留了一台裝著原始硬碟的舊電腦，讓客人看看二十年前的網路長什麼樣子。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼大部分網咖都關了？
options: 老闆們都覺得太累而退休了
現在幾乎家家都有網路

questions.questionZh: 學校附近那家網咖現在變成什麼？
options: 一家賣舊電腦的二手店

items.promptZh: 我把所有的照片都存在這個硬碟裡。
referenceEn: I keep all my photos on this hard drive.
I have saved all my photos on this hard drive.
rubricZh: 「硬碟」可寫，例如 hard drive 等
「存在…裡」可寫，例如 keep … on、save … on、store … on 等
時態配合內容（例如 keep、have saved 等）

items.promptZh: 這個標題結尾的驚嘆號讓它看起來更有趣。
referenceEn: The exclamation mark at the end of this title makes it look more interesting.
This title looks more interesting because of the exclamation mark at the end.
rubricZh: exclamation mark 指驚嘆號（例如 the exclamation mark at the end 等）
「讓它看起來」可寫，例如 makes it look…、looks… because of… 等
「更有趣」用比較級（例如 more interesting、more fun 等）
